Black Friday could see $149,000 spent online every second.

Adobe forecasts US shoppers will spend $12.9 billion online on Black Friday, Nov 27, 2026, up 9.2% on last year, with about $807 million of it on pay-later plans (BNPL). A day has 86,400 seconds, so that is about $149,000 a second. This is a forecast; the real total comes out after the weekend.
